name: CardoAI ABF MCP
description:
CardoAI ABF MCP gives Claude read-only access to your CardoAI asset-backed finance platform. You can discover the securitization transactions your account is authorized for (by name or asset class), browse the preconfigured analytics views available for a transaction, inspect which columns support filtering, and retrieve analytics result tables — optionally narrowed by region, value thresholds, dates, or status flags.

The connector is strictly read-only: it retrieves data and never creates, modifies, or deletes anything. Results reflect each transaction’s most recent synchronized portfolio snapshot. All access is governed by OAuth and per-transaction authorization scopes, so the connector can only return data for transactions the authenticated account is permitted to see.

_published_faq.name: How do I add CardoAI ABF MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add CardoAI ABF MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://abf-backend.uat.cardoaiapps.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the CardoAI ABF MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: CardoAI ABF MCP provides these MCP tools: get_filterable_columns, get_stratification_analytics_data, list_resources, list_transaction_analytics, list_transactions, and read_resource.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to CardoAI ABF MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to CardoAI ABF MCP in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does CardoAI ABF MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: CardoAI ABF MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
CardoAI ABF MCP is developed by CardoAI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
